purpose: Token-friendly registry for when Codex should suggest optional Skills, macros, MCP usage, verification, documentation, or cleanup.
rules: Required context/rules are loaded silently and are not framed as optional suggestions.
Pause before optional side effects, external writes, significant runtime, or optional MCP/tool usage.
After normal work, suggest at most two useful follow-ups when they add clear value.
Do not suggest extra workflows for trivial prompts or obvious one-step answers.
Macros remain explicit; suggest @wb codes when useful, but never silently infer them from normal wording.

categories.when: User reports a bug in a linked external project and has not already invoked a macro.
categories.impact: Loads project/rules context, may edit external source if approved by the request, records change after work.

categories.when: User asks for cleanup/refactor in a linked external project without a macro.
categories.impact: Loads rules, preserves behavior, may edit external source, records change.

categories.when: Task touches scenes, prefabs, hierarchy, ScriptableObjects, shaders, layers, sorting layers, or ProjectSettings.
categories.impact: Loads Unity context and rules; may touch external Unity files only for narrow safe edits.

categories.when: Unity context may be stale or Unity-relevant files changed.
categories.impact: Reads Unity project and writes workbench context only.

categories.suggest: Unity MCP check or batchmode tests/log tail
categories.when: Editor/runtime state, serialized references, package restore, playmode behavior, or logs would materially improve confidence.
categories.impact: May run MCP or Unity batchmode; can take time and may write ignored logs/results under project .ai/tmp.

categories.when: User asks for raster art, sprites, textures, mockups, concepts, or project-matching visuals.
categories.impact: May generate image files; accepted outputs should be registered in asset manifests.

categories.when: User is retrying after a failed/stalled task or asks what went wrong previously.
categories.impact: Reads attempts/recent changes; writes a new attempt note only if useful failure/recovery context is discovered.

categories.when: Task is multi-file, architectural, history-querying, fuzzy, or scope is unclear.
categories.impact: Reads retrieval policy and project scope; proposes grep/index, RAG, or hybrid retrieval before work. Does not write external project files.

categories.when: Upcoming work is simple enough for local/free model use or the user wants to avoid extra spend.
categories.impact: Starts a new Codex session with Ollama local models only. Does not use API keys, cloud models, or new billing.

categories.when: The user explicitly asks to use Claude Code through an existing Claude.ai subscription.
categories.impact: Uses Claude Code only when forceLoginMethod=claudeai is configured. Refuses Anthropic Console/API billing, provider credits, cloud model billing, or new subscriptions.

categories.when: After substantive code changes, especially refactors, multi-file edits, Unity lifecycle work, or performance-sensitive changes.
categories.impact: Reads rules, project context, and the requested scope. Writes a findings-only review note under the project .ai area. Does not patch source.

categories.when: User gives a repeated preference, correction, or rule that should persist.
categories.impact: Writes compact feedback memory under root or project .ai/feedback.

categories.when: A solved or paused task has useful next-step context worth preserving.
categories.impact: Writes a lightweight timestamped handoff note; does not create a full session.

categories.when: Work is long, strategic, or the user explicitly cares about documenting the session.
categories.impact: Creates timestamped project session folders/files; normal work does not use this automatically.

categories.suggest: Required indexes, rules, and project context
categories.when: Context is mandatory for correctness, such as AGENTS.md, project index, live-project rules, or Unity context before Unity edits.
categories.impact: Read-only context loading; do not ask before doing required context work.
